text: PSR J1913 plus 1102 is the decisive pair. Pulsar timing gives masses of 1.599 ± 0.008 and 1.290 ± 0.008 times the sun's mass. Relative to the heavier star, the difference is 19.3 ± 0.7%. The source's limit was 4%, so the observed difference is nearly 5 times the threshold and its 95.4% interval stays above 4% by a wide margin. The system is treated in the refereed literature as a double neutron star. The asymmetry was published in 2020 and sharpened by the 2026 timing update.
